hints.title: Length Difference Pre-Filter
hints.text: Compare the lengths of the two strings. If the absolute length difference exceeds one, they cannot be one edit distance apart.

hints.title: First Character Mismatch Inspection
hints.text: Iterate until the first index where characters differ. The remaining tails must be identical under the assumed single edit operation.

hints.title: Single-Character Bypass Tail Comparison
hints.text: When lengths are equal, verify whether suffixes starting from the next index match. When lengths differ, verify whether the shorter string matches the longer string suffix starting one character ahead.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full dynamic programming edit distance requires quadratic O(M * N) time and space for a problem with an edit threshold of exactly 1.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Early termination on the first character discrepancy checks tail equality in a single linear pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle three cases cleanly: single replacement (m==n), single insertion (n==m+1), and identical strings.
